findings.statement: ChemGraph, ACRA, ChemCrow, and Workflow Run RO-Crate support only their recorded narrow propositions; inaccessible or insufficient passages remain unresolved, and empty Crossref relation fields are not global correction or retraction clearance.
findings.defect_hypothesis: An adjacent architecture reference, incomplete publisher passage, or metadata-only observation could be expanded into a performance, scientific-validity, or SOTA proposition.
findings.impact: The literature statements remain qualified and cannot support a ChemSmart comparative claim.
findings.safety_red_line: No snippet, title, or empty metadata field may be used as scientific evidence or correction clearance.
findings.limitation: P4 does not obtain additional publisher passages or correction-index access.
